An operator rotating funds across many keys as a result bleeds value on each hop, which is a cost an agent that leaves its stake in place never burns. Withdrawing stake burns a 6% fee that is burned rather than redistributed, so moving capital between aliases destroys a slice of it every time. That is 27 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
